cases.sentence: ___ Господень возвал к нему с неба.
cases.translation: The angel of the Lord called to him from heaven.
cases.explain: Ангел is the subject of возвал, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Авраам взял дрова для ___ и положил их на спину Исааку.
cases.translation: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac's back.
cases.explain: The preposition для governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Isaac said to his father Abraham, 'Father?'
cases.explain: The verb сказать takes its addressee in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Бог сказал, «Возьми ___, своего единственного сына Исаака, которого ты любишь».
cases.translation: God said, 'Take your son, your only son Isaac, whom you love.'
cases.explain: The verb взять takes its direct object in the accusative case; being animate, the accusative matches the genitive form.

cases.translation: Your offspring will possess the cities of their enemies.
cases.explain: The verb овладеть (to take possession of) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Иди в землю Мория и принеси его там в жертву всесожжения на ___, на которую я укажу тебе.
cases.translation: Go to the land of Moriah and offer him there as a burnt offering on the mountain that I will show you.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Спустя какое-то время Бог подверг Авраама испытанию.
reading.question: What did God do to Abraham at the start of this chapter?
options: He blessed him with more children
He punished him for a sin
reading.explain: The text opens by saying God 'подверг Авраама испытанию' — tested Abraham.

reading.ru: На другой день рано утром Авраам встал, оседлал осла, взял с собой двух слуг и сына Исаака, нарубил дров для всесожжения и отправился в путь к тому месту, о котором сказал ему Бог.
reading.question: What did Abraham prepare before setting out?
options: A donkey, two servants, his son Isaac, and wood for a burnt offering
A tent and food for many days
Gold to trade along the way
reading.correct: A donkey, two servants, his son Isaac, and wood for a burnt offering
reading.explain: The text lists the donkey, two servants, Isaac, and the wood he cut for the offering.

reading.ru: Бог сам усмотрит ягненка для всесожжения, сын мой.
reading.question: How did Abraham answer Isaac's question about the lamb?
options: God himself would provide the lamb
They would buy one on the way
Isaac himself was to be the offering
They would return home without one
reading.correct: God himself would provide the lamb
reading.explain: Abraham told Isaac that God himself would provide the lamb for the burnt offering.

reading.ru: Но ангел Господень возвал к нему с неба.
reading.question: What stopped Abraham from killing his son?
options: The angel of the Lord called to him from heaven
Isaac ran away from the altar
A ram appeared before he raised the knife
reading.correct: The angel of the Lord called to him from heaven
reading.explain: The text says the angel of the Lord called to Abraham from heaven, stopping him.

reading.ru: Авраам поднял взгляд и увидел барана, который запутался рогами в зарослях.
reading.question: What did Abraham see caught in the thicket?
options: A ram caught by its horns
A lamb tied to a tree
reading.correct: A ram caught by its horns
reading.explain: The text says Abraham saw a ram caught by its horns in the thicket.

reading.ru: Прошло время, и Аврааму сказали, «Милка тоже стала матерью, родила сыновей твоему брату Нахору.
reading.question: What news did Abraham receive at the end of the chapter?
options: That Milcah had borne sons to his brother Nahor
That Lot had returned to him
reading.correct: That Milcah had borne sons to his brother Nahor
reading.explain: The text says Abraham was told that Milcah had borne sons to his brother Nahor.
